logline: Standing before the smoldering ash of their home, Juliana and Alexander receive shelter and food from grateful villagers before Alexander meets in secret with a loyal spy, learning that his usurping enemies have imprisoned his mother and claimed his ducal seat.

candidates.rationale: High-impact opening confrontation immediately establishes the emotional stakes with no prior context required.
candidates.judge_rationale: Strong opening hook, intense cliffhanger, and crystal-clear melodrama dynamics.

candidates.hook_text: We will not forget this kindness.
candidates.cliffhanger_text: Lord Sterling's influence has grown since your disappearance. He has men in the county offices, the courts, even among the household staff.
candidates.rationale: Pivotal dramatic shift where a public insult turns into an explosive confrontation.
candidates.judge_rationale: Strong opening hook, intense cliffhanger, and crystal-clear melodrama dynamics.

candidates.hook_text: Alexander lifts his gaze toward the cold forest canopy, his breathing heavy with profound anguish.
candidates.cliffhanger_text: Alexander sits down beside her in the straw. Juliana leans gently against his shoulder, letting her weary head rest against his broad chest.
candidates.rationale: Episode climax building directly to the final unresolved revelation before cut to black.
candidates.judge_rationale: Strong opening hook, intense cliffhanger, and crystal-clear melodrama dynamics.
